description: Defines the ParallelGuard class in the c10 namespace, implementing RAII-based thread-local guard to track execution within parallel loop functions such as at::parallel_for or at::parallel_reduce.

classes.name: ParallelGuard

methods.description: Constructor that sets the thread’s parallel execution state.
